subject: Status: pipeline hardened, acceptance curves in, one cap decision needed
body:
Hi both,

Status. The hardened pipeline shipped on time: the full chain from enumerate_stoichiometries through reject_to_uniform and aggregate_uniform_samples now runs as a managed batch workflow with checkpointing per stoichiometry, and the stats_to_csv outputs feed a dashboard so we can watch acceptance rates live. Saoirse also added graphml validation between stages, which already caught two malformed batches.

Yara's acceptance curves are in: at C,N,O,F, rejection-to-uniform acceptance is comfortable through 6 heavy atoms, marginal at 7 (about 5x the CPU cost of 6), and genuinely bad at 8 - her projection says 8-heavy-atom uniformity would eat the entire remaining CPU budget for maybe 4% of the library.

Decision needed by 5/15: cap the reference library at 7 heavy atoms and document the cap, or descope elsewhere. Team recommendation is the cap.

Wanjiru
